message: nat_console::config::get_config_info is named like an accessor but its callee graph has effects: reads-world
why: get_config_info reads /lib/systemd/system/nat.service off disk and clap-parses its ExecStart line on the fall-through path (config.rs:37 -> 44-89); the effect is buried one call deep behind a getter name, which is the lie #6 is about.

why: get_nftables_rules forks four /usr/sbin/nft subprocesses (174, 184, 197, 210); a get_-named free function that spawns four processes per call misstates its cost to every caller, and both handlers call it once per request with no cache.
